How long does it take to design a website?

The timeline depends on the size and complexity of the project. A simple urgent single-page website may be completed quickly, while a standard small business website can take several days. Larger websites with custom features may require more time for planning, design, development, and testing.

Will my website work on mobile devices?

Yes. Responsive design is an important part of our professional website design Houston services. Your website is designed to work across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes. If your current website looks outdated, is difficult to use, or no longer represents your business properly, we can review the existing site and discuss a website redesign. We can also help preserve important pages and content during the process.
